items: Bank precedes the actual Frame initializer and original iterator formation.
Frame, iterator and path borrows stay within the synchronous nonrecursive probe; no user callback, detached owner or verdict cache.
Separate initial-reservation, zero-authentication and work primitive lexical call frames are prepaid.
Positive payment occurs once; zero-byte authentication still precedes every original one-unit work event.
The direct lent-work rejection remains before the new bank.
All result/error values are consumed before reusing their receiving slots.
Whole former compact producer is byte-identical in a closed test module; former wide producer and both existing flat-probe tests remain unchanged.
Actual IR/DAG types used throughout; no synthetic layout stand-ins.
Scope remains partial: default product budgets still fail; private 128MiB graphs only quantify reduction.
